main.description: A status change on a booking thread, written by a participant.

project.description: The project the thread is with. Set on the root account's opening record, which the app trusts over the project the inquiry names.

promoter.description: Who opened the thread. Set on the root account's opening record, which the app trusts over the author of whichever inquiry it reads first.

announcedShow.description: The public show a manager announced from the thread. Set on a record the root writes, which keeps the thread's status and is the only one the app trusts for it. The show names no booking, so nothing public points at this space.

langs.description: The languages the note is written in.

onBehalfOf.description: Set when the root account writes for a participant whose PDS does not support atproto spaces yet.
